note: Master recipe book. The game loads this at boot. SPELLS.md is the prose companion. Edit here or in Tools/catalog-editor.html.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.want: Hunger sent. Fire that flies.

spells.name: Flame-pillar
spells.want: Hunger given a body and asked to rest. It stands.

spells.name: Melt
spells.want: A stood fire-body sent into a thing. Salt keeps it from flying. Stone and steel remember they were liquid. Obsidian will not.

spells.name: Smother
spells.want: Hunger needs breath; that breath is withheld.

spells.name: Sun-lance
spells.want: Hunger shown, given breath, sent as a clean line.

spells.name: Ignite
spells.want: Hunger’s wildcard given a standing body — a wick that stays.

spells.name: Lightning
spells.want: Hunger given breath and sent. A bolt, not a body.

spells.name: Chain
spells.want: That bolt finds yield given a body. The pool is what dies.

spells.name: Live-floor
spells.want: The seed given a body around your feet. They cannot step.

spells.name: Jolt
spells.want: The bolt, turned by Sulphur, reaches a mind. They lock.

spells.name: Thunderclap
spells.want: The bolt meets rest, then every mind around you.

spells.name: Storm
spells.want: The hanging veil given a body, then the bolt is sent from it.
spells.recipe: Air · Water · Salt · Fire · Air · Mercury

spells.name: Rain
spells.want: The hanging veil yields more and is sent down.

spells.name: Fog
spells.want: The hanging veil is drawn to the ground.

spells.name: Scald
spells.want: Hunger forced through yield, given a body, sent.

spells.name: Water-jet
spells.want: Yield learns breath so it can leave the vessel, then is sent.

spells.name: Flood
spells.want: Yield going, more yield, given a body. They bog.

spells.name: Ice-pillar
spells.want: Hard water asked to rest as a column. Over a pit it must join two floors, or it falls. On water it freezes without banks. It will thaw.

spells.name: Ice-spear
spells.want: Hard water sent.

spells.name: Snowfall
spells.want: The veil is given ice’s story and sent softly.

spells.name: Thaw
spells.want: The hard water-body meets hunger and remembers yield.

spells.name: Hurled stone
spells.want: Rest given a body and sent. Earth flies.

spells.name: Wall
spells.want: A body of rest asked to rest as more rest. A wall. Across a pit it is a two-tile span that must find floor or wall at each end, or it falls. Water takes mud, not a bridge.

spells.name: Pit
spells.want: Rest asked to go, given breath so it leaves a hollow.

spells.name: Bridge
spells.want: A body of rest given breath and sent across. A two-tile span that must find floor or wall at each end, or it falls. Water takes mud, not a bridge.

spells.name: Quagmire
spells.want: Rest meeting yield, given a body. It holds them.

spells.name: Lava-flood
spells.want: Hungry earth given a body and sent.

spells.name: Obsidian path
spells.want: Hungry earth quenched and given a body. A path.

spells.name: Sprout
spells.want: A vegetable body marked living, from the feet. Plant cover in a three-tile disk.

spells.name: Vine
spells.want: The vegetable body sent. A climbing line from you to the mark. It holds them, and hunger can run it as a wick. A spell — the field speaks Plant.

spells.name: Grow
spells.want: A living vegetable body sent. Plant cover at the mark, the way Sprout stands from the feet.

spells.name: Mend
spells.want: A living body, yield and rest, sent into the living.

spells.name: Hop
spells.want: Breath given a body, then more breath, kept on you. A leap.

spells.name: Flight
spells.want: Breath given logos and breath again, going, then stood on you. You fly. Recast the same breath to land.

spells.name: Rage
spells.want: Fire sent, turned by Sulphur, into a mind.

spells.name: Terror
spells.want: The withheld reaches a mind. They flee or freeze.

spells.name: Lull
spells.want: Yield reaches a mind. They sleep. They can be woken.

spells.name: Gale
spells.want: Breath going, more breath, given a body so it can push.

spells.name: Veil
spells.want: The withheld, a living body, as breath. Hard to see.

spells.name: Call beast
spells.want: Flesh, marked living, given a mind, sent here. Know the formula.
spells.recipe: Earth · Water · Salt · Life · Sulphur · Mercury

spells.name: Blight
spells.want: A vegetable body, then the grave, given a body. Verdure rots.

spells.name: Shade
spells.want: Withheld, given a body, marked by the grave, and sent.

spells.name: Unmake
spells.want: The grave is sent into a living body.

spells.name: Grave-sleep
spells.want: The waking passion is given to the grave. Sleep as if dead.

spells.name: Corpse-call
spells.want: One grave is opened and a mind is sent. They rise and serve while you hold the sentence.
spells.recipe: Salt · Water · Earth · Fire · Death · Mercury

spells.name: Grave-dust
spells.want: Rest marked by the grave. Earth-life and golems come apart.

spells.name: Snuff
spells.want: Hunger marked by the grave and sent into a flame.

spells.name: Blackout
spells.want: The seed marked by the grave and sent. A live rod dies.

spells.name: Dark-crystal
spells.want: Crystal withheld and marked by the grave. They freeze in dark glass. Free masonry — easier than obsidian, notorious among Free sorcerers.

spells.name: Last breath
spells.want: Living breath, then the grave, sent. The breath leaves them.

spells.name: Time-stop
spells.want: Yield and rest are withheld. The living stay; the mind cannot hurry. The stopped moment stands.
spells.recipe: Water · Earth · Dark · Life · Sulphur · Salt

spells.name: Douse
spells.want: Yield sent. Water thrown. Hunger ends.

spells.name: Command
spells.want: A standing body given a mind and sent. They obey.

spells.name: Wind
spells.want: Breath sent. Wind.

spells.name: Earth-pillar
spells.want: Rest given a body. A column of earth. Over a pit it must join two floors, or it falls. Water takes mud, not a span.

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.want: Rest given a body, then the mind holds it on you. Earth and crushing — boulders, slams, arrows — break.

spells.name: Water ward
spells.want: Yield given a body, then the mind holds it on you. Water breaks. You walk on yield.

spells.name: Flame ward
spells.want: Hunger given a body, then the mind holds it on you. Fire breaks.

spells.name: Wind ward
spells.want: Breath given a body, then the mind holds it on you. Air breaks. Fog and foul breath leave.

spells.name: Lava-pillar
spells.want: Hungry earth given a standing body. It stands. Yield cools it to rock.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.want: A stood wall given breath and sent. Matter comes apart.

spells.name: Confuse
spells.want: Breath turned by Sulphur, into a mind. They lose the thread.

spells.name: Ice-wall
spells.want: A body of ice asked to stand as more ice. A wall. Across a pit it is a two-tile span that must find floor or wall at each end, or it falls. On water it freezes without banks. It will thaw.

spells.name: Freeze
spells.want: Hard water held as a condition. They freeze.

spells.name: Snowstorm
spells.want: The veil given ice’s story, then driven. They freeze.
spells.recipe: Air · Water · Water · Earth · Air · Mercury

spells.name: Push
spells.want: Breath given a body and sent. Wind that pushes the person.

spells.name: Lightning strike
spells.want: A spark given form from the air, moving at something. It falls from the sky.

spells.name: Charm
spells.want: A living mind is reached and sent. They fetch, and they fight what you have marked.

spells.name: Swamp
spells.want: Rest meeting yield, going, given a body around your feet. A watery swamp.

spells.name: Witchfire
spells.want: Fire given logos and its own perpetuity, then sent. Witchfire. It eats what ordinary hunger cannot.

spells.name: Wither
spells.want: The vegetable body is withheld. Plants around your feet die. What remains speaks Death.

spells.name: Thunder
spells.want: The arc meeting rest.

spells.name: Darkness
spells.want: The hanging veil is withheld. Nothing in the vicinity can see.

spells.name: Blizzard
spells.want: The veil given ice, a body, going, and wind.
spells.recipe: Air · Water · Salt · Water · Earth · Mercury · Air · Mercury
spells.via: Cloud · Salt · Ice · Mercury · Air · Mercury

spells.name: Sandstorm
spells.want: Breath going, driving grit.

spells.name: Water-pillar
spells.want: Yield and rest given a standing body. A column of water.

spells.name: Oil shot
spells.want: Fuel sent. Surfaces hold flame. Fire already standing grows.
spells.recipe: Water · Salt · Earth · Fire · Earth · Mercury

spells.name: Oil-pillar
spells.want: A stood wick. A later fire sentence would make it a bomb.
spells.recipe: Water · Salt · Earth · Fire · Earth · Salt · Earth

spells.name: Poison spray
spells.want: The grave of a plant, sent as a stream. It poisons what it crosses.

spells.name: Miasma
spells.want: The hanging veil forced through acid. Foul breath.

spells.name: Plasma
spells.want: Witchfire joined to the bolt and sent. Ordinary matter ends. Obsidian and warded stone refuse it.
spells.recipe: Fire · Animus · Fire · Fire · Air · Air · Mercury

spells.name: Fire-pillar
spells.want: Hunger given a standing body. A column of fire. Without a source it goes out in a few seconds.

spells.name: Monsoon
spells.want: Yield given a body and sent. A remote flood. The monsoon.

spells.name: Dirt toss
spells.want: Rest sent without a body. Loose dirt. It smothers ground-fire and leaves Earth speaking where it lands.

spells.name: Metal-pillar
spells.want: Hungry earth given spark and asked to stand. A column of iron. It hangs without a far bank.
spells.recipe: Fire · Earth · Fire · Air · Earth · Salt · Earth

spells.name: Metal-wall
spells.want: A body of iron asked to stand as more iron. A wall. Over a gap it needs no far rest.
spells.recipe: Fire · Earth · Fire · Air · Earth · Salt · Fire · Earth · Fire · Air · Earth

spells.name: Obsidian-wall
spells.want: A body of black glass asked to stand as more black glass. A wall. Melt, Shatter, and hunger's thaw will not take it. Over a gap it needs no far rest.
spells.recipe: Fire · Earth · Salt · Water · Salt · Fire · Earth · Salt · Water

spells.name: Balm
spells.want: Care sent. Yield given mind and rest, then sent. It heals.

spells.name: Chorus
spells.want: Care given a body around the feet. The work opens to many.

spells.name: Drive
spells.want: Hunger given mind and breath, then sent. Logos sent. It goes out and does not return.

spells.name: Tree
spells.want: A living vegetable body given a standing body. A tree. Over a pit it must join two floors, or it falls. On water it grows a walkable cover without banks. Hunger eats it.

spells.name: Wood-wall
spells.want: A living plant asked to stand as more living plant. A line of trees. Across a pit it is a two-tile span that must find floor or wall at each end, or it falls. On water it grows a walkable cover without banks. Hunger eats it.
spells.recipe: Water · Salt · Earth · Life · Salt · Water · Salt · Earth · Life

spells.name: Oil puddle
spells.want: Fuel given a standing body. A puddle. Surfaces hold flame.
spells.recipe: Water · Salt · Earth · Fire · Earth · Salt

spells.name: Oil geyser
spells.want: A stood fountain of fuel, sent to a point. Hunger that finds it will not leave — it burns as hall-fire does, until yield is thrown.
spells.recipe: Water · Salt · Earth · Fire · Earth · Salt · Mercury

spells.name: Oil slick
spells.want: Fuel given a body, then more fuel. It runs outward from a point and covers a wide floor.
spells.recipe: Water · Salt · Earth · Fire · Earth · Salt · Water · Salt · Earth · Fire · Earth

spells.name: Forest
spells.want: A living plant opened to many, then more living plant. It drinks every water still on the screen and covers the pool to the edge of what you can see.
spells.recipe: Water · Salt · Earth · Life · Water · Sulphur · Earth · Water · Salt · Earth · Life

spells.name: Tainted-tree
spells.want: The grave of a plant given a standing body and asked to rest. A tainted tree. It weeps poison onto adjacent tiles until it is destroyed.
spells.recipe: Water · Salt · Earth · Death · Salt · Earth

spells.name: Plant ward
spells.want: A living plant stood, then the mind holds it on you. Plant, yield, and rest break. Green springs from your feet as you walk.
spells.recipe: Water · Salt · Earth · Life · Salt · Sulphur

spells.name: Flame-form
spells.want: Witchfire given a body, then the mind holds you as that body. Hunger cannot take you. The walk kindles.

spells.name: Tide-form
spells.want: Yield given eros and yield again, stood, held. Water cannot take you. You walk it, and the walk is wet.

spells.name: Stone-form
spells.want: Rest given eros and rest again, stood, held. Earth and crushing cannot take you.

spells.name: Gale-form
spells.want: Breath given logos and breath again, stood, held. You become invisible. Enemies lose your trail. Air cannot take you. Fog and foul breath leave as you walk.

spells.name: Grove-form
spells.want: A living plant given eros and the living plant again, stood, held. You become the grove. Green springs as you walk.
spells.recipe: Water · Salt · Earth · Life · Water · Sulphur · Earth · Water · Salt · Earth · Life · Salt · Sulphur
spells.via: Plant · Life · Anima · Plant · Life · Salt · Sulphur

spells.name: Cloud-form
spells.want: The hanging veil given logos and eros and the veil again, stood, held. You become mist and fly. Pits and water cannot hold you.
spells.recipe: Air · Water · Fire · Sulphur · Air · Water · Sulphur · Earth · Air · Water · Salt · Sulphur
spells.via: Cloud · Animus · Anima · Cloud · Salt · Sulphur

spells.name: Acid rain
spells.want: The hanging veil forced through acid and sent down.

spells.name: Metal rain
spells.want: The hanging veil given iron and sent down. Needles.

spells.name: Lava rain
spells.want: The hanging veil given hungry earth and sent down.

spells.name: Ember rain
spells.want: The hanging veil given hunger and sent down.

spells.name: Spark rain
spells.want: The hanging veil given the seed and sent down.

spells.name: Oil rain
spells.want: The hanging veil given fuel and sent down.

spells.name: Ash rain
spells.want: The hanging veil given what hunger left and sent down.

spells.name: Plant rain
spells.want: The hanging veil given a vegetable body and sent down. They root.

spells.name: Death-cloud
spells.want: The hanging veil is withheld, marked by the grave, given logos, and sent.

spells.name: Air-wall
spells.want: Breath given a body, more breath, sent as a span. A wall of wind. They go.

spells.name: Glacier
spells.want: Hard water given logos and itself again, then sent. Ordinary fire cannot take it.

spells.name: Cleanse
spells.want: Shown, given a body of yield, and sent into you. Poison and the lesser holds lift.

spells.name: Turn
spells.want: The waking is given to the grave and a mind is sent. They walk as the dead. Know their formula.

spells.name: Animate
spells.want: Many graves are opened and opened to many. They rise together.
spells.recipe: Salt · Water · Earth · Fire · Death · Anima · Mercury

spells.name: Death-host
spells.want: The four as a grave-body, opened to many, the mind holds. The host does not end until focus breaks.
spells.recipe: Salt · Water · Earth · Fire · Death · Anima · Sulphur

spells.name: Exorcism
spells.want: Shown waking, sent. The dead cannot hold.

spells.name: Wolfsbane
spells.want: A living plant given yield and sent. Wolfsbane. A patch grows from the mark. Yield walks it. Poison turns it.
spells.recipe: Water · Salt · Earth · Life · Water · Mercury

spells.name: Grove-cure
spells.want: A living plant opened to many and sent. Poison lifts around the mark. Blighted green remembers itself.
spells.recipe: Water · Salt · Earth · Life · Water · Sulphur · Earth · Mercury

spells.name: Sun-orb
spells.want: Shown waking, given a body. A sun-orb. Poison lifts. The dead cannot hold. Blighted green remembers itself.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.want: Shown waking, opened to many, given a body. A sanctuary. Poison lifts. The dead cannot hold. Blighted green remembers itself.
spells.recipe: Light · Life · Water · Sulphur · Earth · Salt

spells.name: Spore
spells.want: The grave of a plant given breath and sent. A spore. Foul breath that poisons what it crosses.
spells.recipe: Water · Salt · Earth · Death · Air · Mercury

spells.name: Hemlock
spells.want: A living plant, then the grave, sent. Hemlock. Living venom, stronger than the dead spray.
spells.recipe: Water · Salt · Earth · Life · Death · Mercury

spells.name: Nightshade
spells.want: A living plant, then the grave, given a body. Nightshade. A living poison column. It weeps onto adjacent tiles until it is destroyed.
spells.recipe: Water · Salt · Earth · Life · Death · Salt

spells.name: Briar
spells.want: A stood living plant sent. Briar. It holds them, and hunger can run it as a wick.
spells.recipe: Water · Salt · Earth · Life · Salt · Mercury

spells.name: Float
spells.want: Breath going, then stood on you. You hang. Pits will not take you. You barely walk. Wind, a vine, or a jet of yield moves you. Recast the same breath to land.

spells.name: Wood arrow
spells.want: A vegetable body given a shaft and sent. Wood flies.
